name: Turnover Bridge
description: Turnover Bridge is a 2-player trick game (more related to Whist than Bridge). 52-card deck, 26 each. Layout: 12 face-down in row + 12 face-up on top + 2 secret hole cards. Spades permanently trump. Play face-up cards or hole cards. When face-up played, turn over card beneath. Win 14+ of 26 tricks. Information warfare: visible cards vs hidden cards.

history.origins: Turnover Bridge is a two-player trick-taking game in the Whist and Honeymoon Bridge family. Honeymoon Bridge refers to any two-player adaptation of Contract Bridge; documented variants include Bridge with Semi-Exposed Dummies, where dummy hands have face-down cards with face-up cards on top and playing a face-up card turns the card beneath face up. Turnover Bridge uses this turnover mechanic with a 12+12+2 layout per player and fixed spades trump. Whist, the classic English trick-taking game, originated in England and was widely played in the 18th and 19th centuries; two-player variants became popular for couples and casual play.
timeline: 20th century: Two-player Bridge adaptations such as Honeymoon Bridge became popular for couples and casual play.

setup.dealing: 12 face-down in row + 12 face-up on top + 2 hidden hole cards.

rules.objective: Win 14 or more of the 26 tricks. Spades are permanent trump. Players use a 12+12+2 layout (12 face-down, 12 face-up on top, 2 hole cards); when a face-up card is played, the card beneath is turned over and becomes available.
rules.gameplay: Play any face-up card or hole card. Follow suit. Trump with spades if void. When face-up card played, turn over card beneath (now available). 2 hole cards kept secret. Highest trump or highest led suit wins trick.

strategy.advanced: Force opponent to reveal weak cards.

variations.name: Play to 100 points
variations.description: Instead of first to 14 tricks, play to 100 points (1 point per trick won).
variations.emptyOverridesReason: Points variant only changes win condition to 100 points; no engine overrides needed.

scoring.description: 14+ tricks wins. Variants: fixed stake or play to 100pts (1pt/trick).
